title: Nomos Ecosystem Configuration (nomos.yaml)
description: Deterministic configuration schema synthesized via Go reflection from config.EcosystemConfig (Law 4 Single Source of Truth).

governance.description: Boundary enforcement and Definition of Done quality gate policies.

boundary.description: Package import and CLI command boundary protections.

allowed_egress_domains.description: Explicit allowlist of permitted outbound domains when egress_mode is allowlist.

allowed_mcp_servers.description: Explicit allowlist of permitted MCP server identifiers on PreToolUse.

blocked_egress_domains.description: Explicit denylist of prohibited outbound domains blocked on PreToolUse.

blocked_mcp_servers.description: Explicit denylist of prohibited MCP server identifiers on PreToolUse.

blocked_read_paths.description: Explicit workspace-relative or host path globs denied for agent read access on PreToolUse.

credential_read_mode.description: PreToolUse credential file read policy: host_deny (default), strict, or taint_only.

egress_mode.description: Outbound agent HTTP/HTTPS egress policy on PreToolUse: standard (default), offline, or allowlist.

enforce.description: Enforce declared boundary constraints during verification.

lock_dependencies.description: Reject unapproved dependency graph mutations in worktrees.

prohibited_commands.description: CLI subcommands disallowed inside this repository.

prohibited_packages.description: Import path substrings disallowed inside this repository.

quality_gates.description: Static AST, test hygiene, and cross-plane verification settings.

architecture_boundaries.description: Declarative directional package import rules enforced across Go AST and polyglot source files.

allow_only.description: Exclusive allowlist of permitted import path patterns for matching source files.

forbid_imports.description: Import path patterns disallowed from matching source files.

from.description: Workspace-relative source file glob governed by this boundary rule.

name.description: Optional human-readable identifier for an architecture boundary rule.

contracts.description: Contract schema parity, UI membrane, and ingress boundaries.

auto_promote.description: Allow automatic graduation of recurring verified invariants.

contracts.description: Specification, JSON Schema, and backend source contract parity settings.

backend_roots.description: Backend source directories verified against contract schemas.

fail_on_stale_obligations.description: Reject verification when an Intent specification changed after its latest SUB-* receipt.

schema_files.description: Generated JSON Schema artifacts verified for Go SSoT byte parity.

spec_roots.description: Intent specification directories audited for contract grounding.

strict_types.description: Require strict structural type alignment across boundaries.

verify_obligations.description: Require executable test bindings (@verifies TC-*) for all specification TC-* vectors.

infra.description: Environment variable and port ingress parity configuration.

fail_on_orphan_env.description: Fail when code reads environment variables absent from templates.

ingress_configs.description: Infrastructure manifest paths audited for port collisions.

port_scan.description: Audit declared service ports for multi-seat collisions.

backend_dto_roots.description: Backend DTO directories paired with frontend roots.

banish_defensive_masks.description: Reject silent fallback masks that conceal contract drift.

fail_on_contract_drift.description: Fail verification when DTO shapes diverge across boundaries.

frontend_roots.description: Frontend component directories audited for defensive masks.

coverage_mode.description: Statement coverage enforcement policy: live (default zero-dep live probes plus artifacts), artifact (on-disk coverage reports only), or off.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from AST gates.

forbidden_literals.description: Hardcoded string or path literals rejected by Law 5.

forbidden_shims.description: Stub or placeholder patterns rejected by the Anti-Shim Gate.

intent_source_roots.description: Directories classified under the Intent plane (Law 7).

intent_twin_mode.description: Cross-plane INT twin enforcement for SUB commits: off (default), feat (require INT twin on feat commits), or strict (require INT twin on all SUB commits).

polyglot_toolchains.description: Enable automatic polyglot test/linter toolchain discovery.

strict_mode.description: Enforce statutory baseline thresholds without relaxation.

substrate_source_roots.description: Directories classified under the Substrate plane (Law 7).

tdd_exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from paired unit test enforcement in TDDGate.

tdd_mode.description: Paired unit test enforcement policy: strict (default when strict_mode=true), ratchet (default when strict_mode=false), diff (require paired or modified test on every touched file), or off.

thresholds.description: Numerical AST complexity, size, clone, and coverage bounds.

max_cognitive_debt_score.description: Maximum allowable per-file Cognitive Debt Score (statutory: 45).

max_file_loc.description: Maximum lines of code per source file (statutory: 400).

max_func_loc.description: Maximum lines of code per function (statutory: 60).

max_func_params.description: Maximum parameter count per function signature (statutory: 8).

max_magic_string_duplication.description: Maximum repeated string literal occurrences per package.

min_clone_lines.description: Minimum AST line span flagged as a structural Type-2 clone.

verify_scope.description: Default verification scope inside task worktrees: diff (default, evaluate modified files and packages) or repo (scan full repository on every verification).
